name: buckley-medium-09
original:
Keep redirected review output readable

Redirected `review` and `review-pr` runs currently write animated spinner frames into logs, making scripted output hard to read and needlessly large. Review progress now animates only when stdout is a terminal and quiet mode is off. A focused test covers interactive, redirected, and quiet behavior.

Validation: `go test ./cmd/buckley -run TestNewReviewProgressOnlyAnimatesOnInteractiveOutput -count=1` and `./scripts/test.sh`.
